plugins.name: Open App
plugins.description: Opens or brings forward an app.

plugins.name: Boosteroid
plugins.description: Everything for Boosteroid. Tells ConsoleDeck which game it's streaming, so each game can have its own profile (Boosteroid · Last Epoch): add one from the + menu while the game is in front, or ahead of time from Boosteroid Game…, which offers the games you streamed before; it falls back to the Boosteroid profile, then Default. While Boosteroid is in front it taps Shift when Boosteroid warns of inactivity, so the stream isn't ended. Toggle AFK on a button keeps the Mac awake and taps a random key every few minutes while you are away; on the phone that button counts down to the inactivity kick. Put End Session and Toggle AFK on buttons in the Boosteroid profile, and every game's profile has them.
commands: display dialog "End the Boosteroid session? Unsaved game progress is lost." buttons {"Cancel", "End Session"} default button "Cancel" cancel button "Cancel" giving up after 10 with icon caution
if gave up of result then return

plugins.name: CPU Usage
plugins.description: Shows total CPU usage, updated every second. A tile on the Phone Companion, apart from the buttons: add it under Phone shows in the Actions window.

plugins.name: Input Language
plugins.description: Switches to one of your enabled keyboard layouts / input languages, or cycles through them.

plugins.name: Press Keys
plugins.description: Presses a key combo in the app in front.

plugins.name: Last Epoch Character
plugins.description: Phone tiles with your Last Epoch character's stats from le-scanner (github.com/mike623/le-tool): level, deaths, playtime, health, resistances... One tile per stat: add it under Phone shows. Updates within 10 s of an import.

plugins.name: Last Epoch Scanner
plugins.description: Runs le-scanner's actions (github.com/mike623/le-tool) from a button: scan the stash, import the character, equip the build in use, open the planner. Needs `le-scanner overlay` or `serve` running. On the phone, the Scan All Tabs button shows whatever le-scanner is running, and each other button its own action while it runs; character stats are the Last Epoch Character tiles.

plugins.name: Memory Usage
plugins.description: Shows memory used in GB, like Activity Monitor, updated every two seconds. A tile on the Phone Companion, apart from the buttons: add it under Phone shows in the Actions window.

plugins.name: Network Usage
plugins.description: Shows download and upload speed, with a chart (download green, upload red), updated every second. A tile on the Phone Companion, apart from the buttons: add it under Phone shows in the Actions window.

plugins.name: Type Password
plugins.description: Types a password into the app in front. Stored encrypted, shown masked.

plugins.name: Satisfactory
plugins.description: Opens Satisfactory Calculator's blueprints, interactive map, or one blueprint's page. Put the buttons on the Boosteroid · Satisfactory profile so they show while it's streaming.

plugins.name: Run Script
plugins.description: Runs a command line you type, with bash on Mac and cmd on Windows, from your home folder.

plugins.name: System
plugins.description: Lock, sleep, volume, input language, log out, restart and shut down.
commands: (Add-Type '[DllImport("user32.dll")]public static extern int SendMessage(int h,int m,int w,int l);' -Name W -PassThru)::SendMessage(0xffff,0x0112,0xF170,2)

plugins.name: Type Text
plugins.description: Types text into the app in front.

plugins.name: Open URL
plugins.description: Opens a web page, or an app link like zoommtg:// or spotify:, in its default app.

plugins.name: Toggle VPN
plugins.description: Connects a Tunnelblick (OpenVPN) configuration, or disconnects it when it's up.
